scripts.predev: if command -v lsof >/dev/null 2>&1 && lsof -i :3000 >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ERROR: Port 3000 is already in use. Another dev server may be running. Run 'pnpm dev:clean' to free it." >&2; exit 1; fi
scripts.dev:clean: if command -v lsof >/dev/null 2>&1; then lsof -ti :3000 | xargs -r kill -9 2>/dev/null || true; fi; rm -rf .next node_modules/.cache && pnpm dev
scripts.test: echo "frontend: no unit tests (e2e via pnpm run test:e2e)"
scripts.test:e2e: NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-e2e next build && NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-e2e next start -p 3100
